title: Juicy Fart
blurb: Not one fart but a recital. Seven seconds contain a hissing overture, a volley of quick pops, a fat middle movement, and a finale that sputters through more textures than seems anatomically advisable. The juicy label describes the mastering as much as the material: this file runs noticeably hotter than its neighbours, with the moisture pushed right to the front of the mix. Fail compilations reach for this class of audio when one blast cannot carry a whole timeline. Warn anyone on headphones before you press it, or don't, depending entirely on the relationship.
origin: A generic multi-part fart recording, mastered loud.
